7_generic_v4_rule: Separate OPENING_SIDE relations from PHYSICAL_JAMB surfaces. A path span may be consumed ONLY by a jamb record that is physical by positive source evidence (a drawn cap / band end CAPPED / ALIGNED_FREE_END / OPENING_JAMB of an ESTABLISHED band, or a door / glazed-door strip reveal side); a non-physical record is an annotation and never shortens an edge; a topology closure is classified by its own sources and never consumes or creates wall. Every edge length is conserved per site: wall + column + obstacle + window continuity + physical jamb overlap + excluded + withheld = boundary length (checked, not assumed). Trade eligibility is applied after geometry: door / sliding-door jambs = 0, doorless physical jambs counted once.
